payload.text: When devbin's release carrying 0333-0339 is on the tap, tell intent-vc: Intent's dc re-vendors it and lands Intent's ST0093 (c)-(e). Tell agentic-engineering-vc at the same moment (its P1 devvm build waits on it, decision 159): the version, then 'brew upgrade devbin' and 'bin/devbin upgrade' in each repository, plus any step the as-built adds, such as 0339's serial tag for test shell. intent-vc sends it Intent's half.
